verdict.rationale: Alloy's homepage claims "fully auditable agentic automation" for KYC/KYB and AML checks. That points to a first-party agent working in the compliance-check domain with an audit trail, but it is a single marketing line. No docs show the agent reviewing screening or watchlist matches, or recording a rationale per decision. Missing for 10: documentation of an in-product agent that reviews screening matches, evidence of recorded per-match rationale, details of the review workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to review screening matches with recorded rationale

citations.quote: Streamline perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with fully auditable agentic automation
